facts.lesson: In the Workshop, the Gold Door at (7,6) needs a Gold Key; the key vendor's first visit is the morning of day 3, leaving a Gold Key by the Gold Door. Before day 3 the bench room (workbench at (10,5)) cannot be entered.

In the Workshop, the Notice Board sits at (2,7) and the body can get stuck standing on that tile — all movement directions fail and body_walk_to reports 'no walkable path ... in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)'. Avoid ending up on (2,7).
